camel_example: aliyun cdn DescribeDomainBpsData --region cn-hangzhou --IspNameEn telecom --EndTime '2020-05-14T10:00:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --LocationNameEn beijing --StartTime '2020-05-14T09:50:00Z' --Interval 300
description_en: Queries bandwidth monitoring data for one or more accelerated domain names
kebab_example: aliyun cdn describe-domain-bps-data --domain-name example.com --start-time 2020-05-14T09:50:00Z --end-time 2020-05-14T10:00:00Z --interval 300 --isp-name-en telecom --location-name-en beijing --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainBpsData

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain name. You can specify up to 500 domain names in each request. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).

By default, this operation queries bandwidth data for all accelerated domain names that belong to your Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh:
加速域名，多个域名使用半角逗号（,）分隔，一次最多支持500个域名查询。

默认查询所有加速域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据起始时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

> The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据结束时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

> 结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The time granularity of the data entries. Unit: seconds.

The time granularity varies with the maximum time range per query. Valid values: 300 (5 minutes), 3600 (1 hour), and 86400 (1 day). For more information, see **Usage notes**
parameters.help_zh:
指定查询数据的时间粒度，单位：秒。

根据单次查询的最大时间跨度不同，该参数支持300（5分钟）、3600（1小时）和86400（1天）取值，具体请参见**使用说明**中支持查询的时间粒度
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Internet service provider (ISP). You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to query ISP names.

If you do not set this parameter, data of all ISPs is queried
parameters.help_zh:
运营商英文名，通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html接口获得。

默认查询所有运营商
parameters.name: isp_name_en

parameters.help_en:
The name of the region. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to query regions.

If you do not specify a region, data in all regions is queried
parameters.help_zh:
地域英文名，通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html接口获得。

默认查询所有地域
parameters.name: location_name_en
